analysis.title: Jack Henry & Associates Inc. (JKHY): FY1Q27 Key Takeaways: Decent quarter in a good tape
key_insights: GS calls FY1Q27 a solid quarter. The stock outperformed significantly, which GS attributes to the positive tape and weaker results at peers.
Feedback on the print centered on margin and revenue outperformance. The company left the margin guide unchanged and flagged timing items that make 1H stronger than 2H.
JKHY showed strong momentum on Bank Core wins and continued its recent trend of 'trifecta' deals. It is also leaning into the cyber and payments products recently released to banks.
GS says 1Q benefited from some pull-forward and that the stock reaction looks a bit extreme for relatively modest estimate revisions.

GS expects the stock to stay anchored by the multi-year acceleration trajectory laid out at investor day. At ~23x its C2027 EPS, GS sees shares as relatively fully valued and wants a better entry point or more sustained top line improvement to get more constructive.
Management expects lower non-GAAP revenue growth in 2H. Previously disclosed non-GAAP margin headwinds remain intact for 1H.

Planned increases in cyber and infrastructure investment will keep pressuring FY27 margins. Management reiterated its margin guide of 20-40bps and is cautiously optimistic the range will increase as the year progresses.
Management expects full-year FCF conversion of 85%-100% and a 23.25%-24% GAAP tax rate in FY27.
Core revenue includes on-prem implementations and consulting engagements. Excluding those items, the core segment grew 8.6%.
A product was moved from the Core segment to the Complementary segment in 1Q27 and 1Q26 segment results were recast. The changes are segment-level only and do not affect consolidated results.
GS raised its 12-month price target to $188 from $181, using ~23x on Q5-Q8 EPS versus ~22x previously, on greater visibility to margin expansion. Rating stays Neutral.

market_movers.rationale: PT raised to $188 from $181 on a ~23x multiple of Q5-Q8 EPS, up from ~22x, on greater visibility to margin expansion. GS sees shares as relatively fully valued at ~23x C2027 EPS and wants a better entry point.

earnings_insights: JKHY FY1Q27 reported 11/4: adjusted revenue ~$682mn, about +1% vs consensus.
FY1Q27 adjusted segment income ~$309mn reported vs $301mn consensus, margin ~45.3% reported vs ~44.8% consensus.
FY1Q27 non-GAAP operating income ~$193mn reported vs ~$180mn consensus. GAAP EPS $2.28 reported vs $2.09 Street estimate.

FY2027 company guidance (updated): non-GAAP revenue $2,667mn-$2,687mn including $30mn deconversion fees. Non-GAAP operating expenses $2,024mn-$2,033mn vs consensus ~$2,020mn. Non-GAAP operating income $643mn-$653mn, margin 24.1%-24.3%.
FY2027 company GAAP guidance: revenue $2,698mn-$2,718mn, expenses $2,033mn-$2,043mn, operating income $665mn-$676mn, margin 24.7%-24.9%, GAAP EPS $7.47-$7.51.
GS estimates FY2027/2028/2029 EPS of $7.54/$8.28/$9.18 (GS forecast), from $7.58/$8.35/$9.22 previously. GS quarterly EPS: 9/26 $2.28 reported, 12/26E $1.90, 3/27E $1.71, 6/27E $1.65 (GS forecast).
GS revenue estimates (GS forecast, $mn): FY6/27E 2,709.2 (old 2,707.5), FY6/28E 2,877.4 (old 2,892.2), FY6/29E 3,077.2 (old 3,107.4).
risk_factors: Lower non-GAAP revenue growth in 2H and margin pressure from cyber and infrastructure investment.

tension_points.bull_case: JKHY is executing at a very strong level with momentum on Bank Core wins and 'trifecta' deals. The stock is anchored by the multi-year acceleration trajectory from investor day.
tension_points.bear_case: At ~23x GS C2027 EPS, shares look relatively fully valued. 1Q had pull-forward benefits, 2H revenue growth is guided lower, and the margin guide is unchanged.
tension_points.what_invalidates: A better entry point on valuation or a more sustained improvement in top line momentum would make GS more constructive.
